title: Stuck in a Blizzard All Night: EV or Gas Car? #shorts

scenes.text: You're stuck on a frozen highway all night. Would you rather be in an electric car, or a gas car?
Car and Driver tested it. A Tesla and a Hyundai sat outside in single-digit cold, heat set to sixty-five.
The gas car burned about a third of a gallon an hour. A full tank: roughly fifty-two hours of heat.
The Tesla used about two percent of its battery an hour. A full charge: roughly forty-five hours.
Almost a tie. But snow can block a tailpipe and fill the cabin with deadly carbon monoxide. An E V has no tailpipe.
The E V's catch: start the storm with a low battery, and you're in trouble.
So which car do you want that night? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
